title: Team Rhythm · Teams
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Team Rhythm · Teams with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and agree on a four-beat pattern of claps and pauses. The pair alternates beats so that together they perform the full pattern. The four combined beats match the agreed pattern. Form two teams. Each team has four turns; only the lead’s teammates respond or assist. Each success earns the team one point. The higher team score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Team Rhythm, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The four combined beats match the agreed pattern.
recall.why: The four combined beats match the agreed pattern.
